definitions.gloss: diagram; chart (visual representation of data or relationships)
definitions.explanation: A visual diagram used to illustrate relationships, processes, or data. Used in technical, business, and academic contexts. Often shortened to ダイヤ.

In the context of railways, buses, and other scheduled transport, refers to the operating schedule — the plan of when each train or bus runs. Usually shortened to ダイヤ in this sense, as in {運行|うんこう}ダイヤ (operating schedule) or ダイヤの{乱|みだ}れ (schedule disruption).

examples.japanese: {分|ぶん}かりやすいダイヤグラム。
ダイヤグラム⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}する→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧。
⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ダイヤグラム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{載|の}せて→載せる：28290_noseru⟧⟦わかりやすく→わかりやすい：09582_wakariyasui⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I included a diagram in the meeting materials to make it easier to understand.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ダイヤ→ダイヤ：00032_daiya⟧。
⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ダイヤ→ダイヤ：00032_daiya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乱|みだ}れている→乱れる：09506_midareru⟧。
examples.english: Train service is disrupted due to an accident.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{運行|うんこう}→運行：14375_unkou⟧ダイヤグラム⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The operating schedule was significantly changed due to the typhoon.

notes:
A loanword from English "diagram" that has taken on two distinct uses in Japanese.

USAGE:
In general contexts, ダイヤグラム refers to any visual diagram or chart — the same meaning as English "diagram." In the world of public transport (especially railways), however, the word has a specialized meaning: the operating schedule itself. This comes from the historical use of graphical time-distance charts to plan train operations. In this transport sense, the word is almost always shortened to ⟦ダイヤ→ダイヤ：00032_daiya⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ダイヤグラム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}く→描く：28436_kaku⟧: to draw a diagram
- ⟦ダイヤ→ダイヤ：00032_daiya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乱|みだ}れる→乱れる：09506_midareru⟧: the train schedule is disrupted
- ⟦ダイヤ→ダイヤ：00032_daiya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧: schedule change
- ⟦{運行|うんこう}→運行：14375_unkou⟧⟦ダイヤ→ダイヤ：00032_daiya⟧: operating schedule
- ⟦ダイヤ→ダイヤ：00032_daiya⟧⟦{改正|かいせい}→改正：00446_kaisei⟧: timetable revision (the periodic official schedule update)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{図|ず}→図：03368_zu⟧: figure, diagram — the native Japanese word, broader and more common for visual figures
- ⟦{時刻表|じこくひょう}→時刻表：01031_jikokuhyou⟧: timetable — the printed or posted schedule listing departure times, as opposed to ⟦ダイヤ→ダイヤ：00032_daiya⟧ which refers to the operating plan itself
- ⟦チャート→チャート：11042_chaato⟧: chart — often used for business or statistical charts (bar chart, pie chart, etc.)
